title: The Pythian Temple roof garden with multiple bands
summary: The Pythian Temple stage and balconies held four or five bands on Monday nights.

story.theme_name: Dance halls, lake camps and riverboat bandstands
story.community_name: Dance halls, lake resorts and where bands played

blocks.x: You mentioned we rode by the old Pithian Temple, the roof garden there. Did you tell us anything about it, how it was?
Oh yeah well they had a stage and sometimes they sit two bands on that stage, sometimes one. And they had a balcony all around you see.
Was the stage down lower on the end?

Yeah the band was lower than the balcony. The stage was I guess about four or five feet and a half. But the balcony was way up and they'd have a band on the stage, a band right here on the first part of the balcony, a band on the second part of the man and Perez and Pernacuene. There must have been a house band because they always played that, but it was way up in the balcony in the middle and then right on the other end there was another band. There was at least sometimes four or five bands on a Monday night.
